ctx.x: I want you to tell it in the greatest detail.

Well, there used to be... In those days they had cutting contests, you know. There was a lot of competition and a competitive thing with everybody, because there is no other way... When a new player was heard around, everybody wanted to see him, wanted to know him -- "Where is he? Where can we go?" And that's the way jam sessions were born. So that people gathered around... Tom Tillman was one...
